annotations.title: Say one line to the game

description: Say one line to Plazmi in plain words, as you would at a text adventure: look fern, sit on the sofa, water the garden, go to the plaza, dance with Milo. It does what your resident could do with its other tools, by the game's own command line; check (what: …) and look list what a place or thing takes. It can't run code, can't touch money or glow, and can't sell, give or take anything down: market and let_go do those with the person's say. A line that would cost coins says the cost and changes nothing: call again with confirm true only after the person has agreed. A line can change your resident's own things, a colour or a name among them. What your resident does is public.

confirm.description: Optional: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to the cost a call without it said.

line.description: One line in plain words, like look fern or go to the plaza.
